accountingSchemes.title: Accounting Schemes
accountingSchemes.emptyDescription: Bind a journal template's symbolic account role (e.g. CASH) to a real GL account for a given currency.
accountingSchemes.deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently removes the binding and cannot be undone.

financialPeriods.title: Financial Periods
financialPeriods.emptyDescription: Every journal entry posts against the period covering its transaction date.
financialPeriods.closePeriodConfirmDescription: Once closed, no new journal entries can be posted or reversed against this period. This cannot be undone.
financialPeriods.deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently removes the period and cannot be undone.

generalLedger.title: General Ledger
generalLedger.description: Balances and posted activity for a single GL account within a financial period.
generalLedger.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This account has no posted journal entries in the selected period.
generalLedger.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a GL account and a financial period above to view its ledger.

generalLedger.title: General Ledger
generalLedger.description: Every account's opening, period and closing balances for a financial period.
generalLedger.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view every account's balances.

journalReport.title: Journal Report
journalReport.description: Journal entries filtered by date, branch, status and transaction type.

journalEntryDetails.title: Journal Entry Details
journalEntryDetails.description: Look up a single journal entry by its entry number to view its full detail.
journalEntryDetails.notFound: No journal entry found with that entry number.

reconciliation.title: GL Reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Compares the Loans Receivable control account against loan-service's own portfolio total.
reconciliation.matched: The general ledger and loan portfolio agree.
reconciliation.mismatched: The general ledger and loan portfolio don't agree — investigate before relying on either figure.
reconciliation.explanation: A non-zero variance usually means a missed accounting posting, a manual journal entry that bypassed loan-service, or a bug — not something to ignore.

historyEmpty.title: No history yet
historyEmpty.description: The daily reconciliation check hasn't run yet — history appears here after its first run.

reconciliation.postingsDescription: Every posting to the Loans Receivable account in the current financial period — a starting point for investigating a mismatch.

postingsEmpty.title: No postings this period
postingsEmpty.description: Nothing has posted to the Loans Receivable account in the current financial period yet.

ledgerByBranch.title: Ledger by Branch
ledgerByBranch.description: Posted journal activity across every GL account for a single branch.
ledgerByBranch.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a branch above to view its posted activity. Optionally narrow it to a date range.
ledgerByBranch.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This branch has no posted journal entries in the selected range.

ledgerByDateRange.title: Ledger by Date Range
ledgerByDateRange.description: A GL account's balances and posted activity for a custom date range.
ledgerByDateRange.dateRangeRequired: Select both a from and to date to view this account's ledger.
ledgerByDateRange.emptyTitlePick: Pick an account and date range
ledgerByDateRange.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a GL account and a date range above to view its ledger.
ledgerByDateRange.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This account has no posted journal entries in the selected range.

accountTransactionHistory.title: Account Transaction History
accountTransactionHistory.description: The full posted transaction trail for a GL account, optionally narrowed to a date range.
accountTransactionHistory.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a GL account above to view its transaction history.
accountTransactionHistory.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This account has no posted journal entries yet.

glAccounts.title: Chart of Accounts
glAccounts.emptyDescription: Set up the chart of accounts that journal entries post against.
glAccounts.deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently removes the account and cannot be undone. Accounts with child accounts cannot be deleted.

fields.parentAccountHint: Leave blank for a top-level account

journalEntries.title: Journal Entries
journalEntries.emptyDescription: Record a journal entry to start tracking the general ledger.
journalEntries.validationMissingFields: Please fill in the transaction type, date, branch and currency.

fields.referenceHint: Opaque pointer back to the upstream event, e.g. a loan id

journalTemplates.title: Journal Templates
journalTemplates.emptyDescription: Define the debit/credit legs that fire for a transaction type — e.g. every DISBURSEMENT debits Loan Receivable and credits Cash.
journalTemplates.deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently removes the template and its lines and cannot be undone.

fields.name: Name
fields.rolesHint: Roles are symbolic (e.g. CASH, LOAN_RECEIVABLE) — an accounting scheme binds each one to a real GL account per currency.

trialBalance.title: Trial Balance
trialBalance.description: Posted debit/credit totals per GL account for a financial period.
trialBalance.periodOnlyNote: This period's activity only — no carryforward from prior periods. Generate a snapshot below for the cumulative, ending-balance view.
trialBalance.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No accounts have posted journal entries in the selected period.
trialBalance.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view its trial balance.
trialBalance.snapshotsEmptyDescriptionNoActivity: Generate a snapshot to freeze this period for audit purposes.
trialBalance.snapshotsEmptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to see its snapshots.

adjustedTrialBalance.title: Adjusted Trial Balance
adjustedTrialBalance.description: Debit/credit totals per GL account reflecting every posted journal entry for a period, including adjustments.
adjustedTrialBalance.note: This system does not track adjusting entries separately from regular postings — this report reflects every entry posted for the period.
adjustedTrialBalance.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view its adjusted trial balance.
adjustedTrialBalance.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No accounts have posted journal entries in the selected period.

closingTrialBalance.title: Closing Trial Balance
closingTrialBalance.description: The most recent persisted snapshot for a period — rolled-forward closing balances.
closingTrialBalance.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view its closing trial balance.
closingTrialBalance.emptyDescriptionNoSnapshot: Generate a snapshot for this period on the Trial Balance page to see its closing balances here.

balanceSheet.title: Balance Sheet
balanceSheet.description: Assets, liabilities and equity as of a financial period's end.
balanceSheet.retainedEarningsNote: Computed from cumulative income and expense activity — this system has no period-close process that posts net income into a retained earnings account, so this line is calculated rather than read from the ledger.
balanceSheet.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view its balance sheet.
balanceSheet.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No accounts have posted journal entries as of the selected period.

incomeStatement.title: Income Statement
incomeStatement.description: Income and expenses for a financial period (Profit & Loss).
incomeStatement.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view its income statement.
incomeStatement.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No income or expense accounts have posted journal entries in the selected period.

cashFlow.title: Cash Flow Statement
cashFlow.description: Cash account movements for a date range, grouped by transaction type.
cashFlow.cashAccountPlaceholder: Select the GL account representing cash
cashFlow.note: This is a simplified cash movement summary grouped by transaction type — this system doesn't classify postings into operating, investing or financing activities, so it isn't a formal 3-category cash flow statement.
cashFlow.emptyTitlePick: Pick a cash account and date range
cashFlow.emptyDescriptionPick: Select the GL account representing cash and a date range above.
cashFlow.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This account has no posted journal entries in the selected range.

changesInEquity.title: Statement of Changes in Equity
changesInEquity.description: Opening and closing balances for each equity account over a financial period.
changesInEquity.netIncomeReference: Net income for the period (reference — not included in the equity movements below)
changesInEquity.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view changes in equity.
changesInEquity.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No equity accounts have posted journal entries in the selected period.

portfolioSummary.title: Loan Portfolio Summary
portfolioSummary.description: Active loan count, principal and outstanding balance, with a breakdown by status.

outstandingBalance.title: Outstanding Loan Balance
outstandingBalance.description: Every loan's principal and outstanding balance.

loansReceivable.title: Loans Receivable
loansReceivable.description: Balance and posted activity of the Loans Receivable account for a financial period.
loansReceivable.note: This reflects manually posted journal entries to the Loans Receivable account, not a live computation from the loan portfolio — this system has no automatic posting integration between loan-service and the general ledger, so the two may not reconcile.
loansReceivable.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view this account's ledger.
loansReceivable.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This account has no posted journal entries in the selected period.
loansReceivable.accountNotFound: No "Loans Receivable" account was found in the chart of accounts.

interestReceivable.title: Interest Receivable
interestReceivable.description: Balance and posted activity of the Interest Receivable account for a financial period.
interestReceivable.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view this account's ledger.
interestReceivable.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This account has no posted journal entries in the selected period.
interestReceivable.accountNotFound: No "Interest Receivable" account was found in the chart of accounts.

interestIncome.title: Interest Income
interestIncome.description: Balance and posted activity of the Interest Income account for a financial period.
interestIncome.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view this account's ledger.
interestIncome.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This account has no posted journal entries in the selected period.
interestIncome.accountNotFound: No "Interest Income" account was found in the chart of accounts.

penaltyIncome.title: Penalty Income
penaltyIncome.description: Balance and posted activity of the Penalty Income account for a financial period.
penaltyIncome.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view this account's ledger.
penaltyIncome.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This account has no posted journal entries in the selected period.
penaltyIncome.accountNotFound: No "Penalty Income" account was found in the chart of accounts.

feeIncome.title: Fee Income
feeIncome.description: Balance and posted activity of the Fee Income account for a financial period.
feeIncome.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view this account's ledger.
feeIncome.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This account has no posted journal entries in the selected period.
feeIncome.accountNotFound: No "Fee Income" account was found in the chart of accounts.

aging.title: Accounts Receivable Aging
aging.description: Loan receivables grouped by days past due (DPD).
aging.emptyDescription: No loans currently have an overdue balance.

outstanding.title: Outstanding Receivables
outstanding.description: Total amount owed by customers across all active loans, current vs. overdue.

cashBook.title: Cash Book
cashBook.description: Chronological record of every posting to the Cash and Cash Equivalents account for a date range.
cashBook.accountNotFound: No "Cash and Cash Equivalents" account was found in the chart of accounts.
cashBook.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view the cash book.
cashBook.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No postings to the Cash account in the selected range.

receipts.title: Cash Receipt Report
receipts.description: Cash received (debit postings to the Cash account) for a date range.
receipts.accountNotFound: No "Cash and Cash Equivalents" account was found in the chart of accounts.
receipts.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view cash receipts.
receipts.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No cash was received in the selected range.

payments.title: Cash Payment Report
payments.description: Cash paid out (credit postings to the Cash account) for a date range.
payments.accountNotFound: No "Cash and Cash Equivalents" account was found in the chart of accounts.
payments.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view cash payments.
payments.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No cash was paid out in the selected range.

dailySummary.title: Daily Cash Summary
dailySummary.description: Cash receipts, payments and closing balance for each day in a date range.
dailySummary.accountNotFound: No "Cash and Cash Equivalents" account was found in the chart of accounts.
dailySummary.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view the daily summary.
dailySummary.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No postings to the Cash account in the selected range.

position.title: Cash Position
position.description: The Cash and Cash Equivalents account's cumulative balance as of a chosen date.
position.accountNotFound: No "Cash and Cash Equivalents" account was found in the chart of accounts.

profitAndLoss.title: Branch Profit & Loss
profitAndLoss.description: Income and expenses posted to a branch for a date range.
profitAndLoss.note: Computed by aggregating this branch's posted journal lines for the selected range — there is no pre-aggregated per-branch total in the backend.
profitAndLoss.emptyTitlePick: Pick a branch and date range
profitAndLoss.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a branch and a date range above to view its profit & loss.
profitAndLoss.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This branch has no posted income or expense entries in the selected range.

balanceSheet.title: Branch Balance Sheet
balanceSheet.description: Assets, liabilities and equity posted to a branch, cumulative as of a chosen date.
balanceSheet.note: Computed by aggregating every journal line ever posted to this branch up to the selected date — this system has no pre-aggregated per-branch balance, so this may be slow for a branch with a long history.
balanceSheet.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a branch and an as-of date above to view its balance sheet.
balanceSheet.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This branch has no posted journal entries as of the selected date.

trialBalance.title: Branch Trial Balance
trialBalance.description: Debit/credit totals per account posted to a branch, cumulative as of a chosen date.
trialBalance.note: Computed by aggregating every journal line ever posted to this branch up to the selected date — there is no pre-aggregated per-branch trial balance in the backend.
trialBalance.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a branch and an as-of date above to view its trial balance.
trialBalance.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This branch has no posted journal entries as of the selected date.

cashPosition.title: Branch Cash Position
cashPosition.description: This branch's share of the Cash and Cash Equivalents account balance, as of a chosen date.
cashPosition.accountNotFound: No "Cash and Cash Equivalents" account was found in the chart of accounts.

transactionSummary.title: Branch Transaction Summary
transactionSummary.description: Debit/credit totals per account posted to a branch for a date range.
transactionSummary.emptyTitlePick: Pick a branch and date range
transactionSummary.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a branch and a date range above to view its transaction summary.
transactionSummary.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This branch has no posted journal entries in the selected range.

operatingExpenses.title: Operating Expenses
operatingExpenses.description: Balance and posted activity of the Operating Expenses account for a financial period.
operatingExpenses.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view this account's ledger.
operatingExpenses.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This account has no posted journal entries in the selected period.
operatingExpenses.accountNotFound: No "Operating Expenses" account was found in the chart of accounts.

byBranch.title: Expense by Branch
byBranch.description: Total expenses posted to each branch for a date range.
byBranch.note: Computed by aggregating each branch's posted expense-account activity for the selected range — there is no single backend endpoint for this breakdown.
byBranch.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view expenses by branch.
byBranch.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No branch has posted expense entries in the selected range.

byCategory.title: Expense by Category
byCategory.description: Total expenses posted to each expense account (category) for a financial period.
byCategory.note: This system has only two expense accounts — Loan Write-off Expense and Operating Expenses — so "category" here means expense account.
byCategory.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view expenses by category.
byCategory.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No expense accounts have posted journal entries in the selected period.

byBranch.title: Revenue by Branch
byBranch.description: Total income posted to each branch for a date range.
byBranch.note: Computed by aggregating each branch's posted income-account activity for the selected range — there is no single backend endpoint for this breakdown.
byBranch.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view revenue by branch.
byBranch.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No branch has posted income entries in the selected range.

otherIncome.title: Other Income Report
otherIncome.description: Income posted to any Income-type account other than Interest, Fee, or Penalty Income, for a financial period.
otherIncome.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a financial period above to view other income.
otherIncome.emptyDescriptionNoAccounts: All income in this system is currently tracked under Interest Income, Fee Income, and Penalty Income. To report other income here, create a new Income-type account on the Chart of Accounts page.
otherIncome.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No other income accounts have posted journal entries in the selected period.

byStatus.title: Loans by Status
byStatus.emptyDescription: Try a different search term or status filter.

byBranch.title: Loans by Branch
byBranch.description: Loan count, principal and outstanding balance per branch.
byBranch.emptyDescription: No branch has any loans yet.

byCustomer.title: Loans by Customer
byCustomer.description: Loan count, principal and outstanding balance per customer.
byCustomer.emptyDescription: No customer has any loans yet.

daily.title: Daily Repayment Report
daily.description: Repayments collected, grouped by day, for a date range.
daily.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view daily repayments.
daily.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No payments were collected in the selected range.

monthly.title: Monthly Repayment Report
monthly.description: Repayments collected, grouped by month, for a date range.
monthly.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view monthly repayments.
monthly.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No payments were collected in the selected range.

collection.title: Repayment Collection Report
collection.description: Every repayment collected for a date range, with its principal/interest breakdown.
collection.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view collected repayments.
collection.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No payments were collected in the selected range.

early.title: Early Repayment Report
early.description: Repayments made before their due date, for a date range.
early.note: "Early" is derived by comparing paid date to due date — this system has no dedicated prepayment concept.
early.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view early repayments.
early.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No repayments were made ahead of their due date in the selected range.

collectionDue.title: Collection Due
collectionDue.description: Installments due within the selected window, not yet overdue.
collectionDue.emptyDescription: No installments are due in the selected window.

charges.title: Penalty Charges
charges.description: Penalties charged to loans, for a date range.
charges.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view penalty charges.
charges.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No penalties were charged in the selected range.

waivers.title: Penalty Waivers
waivers.description: Penalties waived, for a date range.
waivers.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view penalty waivers.
waivers.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No penalties were waived in the selected range.

outstanding.title: Penalty Outstanding
outstanding.description: Penalties charged but not yet paid or waived.

collection.title: Penalty Collection
collection.description: Penalties paid, for a date range.
collection.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view collected penalties.
collection.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No penalties were paid in the selected range.

accrued.title: Interest Accrued
accrued.description: Interest accrual entries recorded on loans, for a date range.
accrued.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view accrued interest.
accrued.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No interest accruals were recorded in the selected range.

collected.title: Interest Collected
collected.description: The interest portion of repayments collected, for a date range.
collected.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view collected interest.
collected.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No repayments were collected in the selected range.

outstanding.title: Interest Outstanding
outstanding.description: Interest accrued but not yet collected, per loan.
outstanding.note: Computed as total interest accrued minus total interest collected per loan — this system has no direct "outstanding interest" field, and interest accrual records have no paid/unpaid status of their own.
outstanding.emptyDescription: No loan currently has uncollected accrued interest.

loanHistory.title: Customer Loan History
loanHistory.description: Every loan for a selected customer.
loanHistory.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a customer above to view their loan history.
loanHistory.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This customer has no loans matching the selected filter.

loanSummary.title: Customer Loan Summary
loanSummary.description: Loan totals and status breakdown for a selected customer.
loanSummary.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a customer above to view their loan summary.

paymentHistory.title: Customer Payment History
paymentHistory.description: Every payment across a selected customer's loans.
paymentHistory.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a customer above to view their payment history.
paymentHistory.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: This customer has no payments recorded.

writeoffs.title: Loan Write-offs
writeoffs.description: Write-offs recorded on loans, for a date range.
writeoffs.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view loan write-offs.
writeoffs.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No write-offs were recorded in the selected range.

restructuring.title: Loan Restructuring
restructuring.description: Loans restructured (term/rate changes), for a date range.
restructuring.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view loan restructurings.
restructuring.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No loans were restructured in the selected range.

refinancing.title: Loan Refinancing
refinancing.description: Loans refinanced into a new loan, for a date range.
refinancing.emptyDescriptionPick: Select a from and to date above to view loan refinancing.
refinancing.emptyDescriptionNoActivity: No loans were refinanced in the selected range.

summary.description: Key portfolio metrics at a glance, as of now.
